notes.title: The Launch of Esdraz: The Throne of Darkness
notes.notes:
Hello! We are excited to announce that Esdraz: The Throne of Darkness will be launched at the end of this 2023. Get ready to embark on an epic journey filled with adventure, mystery, and magic.

[previewyoutube=wvEFrLVmgik;full][/previewyoutube]

The game is still in progress so we will keep you informed about the new content added and new upcoming trailers and gameplay.

Some of Esdraz: The Throne of Darkness features are dynamic combat, variety of weapons, and a multiple endings that will keep players engaged for hours on end. With a wide range of weapons to choose from, players will have the freedom to create their own playstyle and defeat their enemies in their own way.


Stay tuned for more updates on this exciting new game, including information on dates, playable demos, and more. "Esdraz: The Throne of Darkness" is not to be missed by any fans of the metroidvania genre.

So mark your calendars for the end of this year, and get ready to join the fight!


- Selecta Play Team
